description: This file implements a generic API client for a web application's admin panel. It provides functions to construct URLs, handle JSON parsing, build request headers with authorization tokens, and perform HTTP requests with support for various methods and query parameters. It also includes helper functions for common HTTP verbs such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path, ensuring no duplicate slashes except for the protocol part.

methods.name: safeParseJson(resp)
methods.description: Safely attempts to parse JSON from a fetch response; returns null if parsing fails.

methods.name: buildHeaders(extra = {}, hasBody = false)
methods.description: Constructs request headers, including JSON content-type and Bearer token if available.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, { method = 'GET', params, body, headers = {}, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the backend API using fetch with consistent behavior, prefixing the base URL, attaching authorization, handling query parameters, and parsing JSON responses.

methods.name: apiGet(path, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience helper for making GET requests.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience helper for making POST requests.

methods.name: apiPut(path, body, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience helper for making PUT requests.

methods.name: apiDelete(path, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience helper for making DELETE requests.

ctags.name: apiRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiRequest(path, { method = 'GET', params, body, headers = {}, signal } = /
